FACT_ID: sec10-R01 | anchor: A01
Walkers anywhere earn readiness, while crosswalk and intersection walkers command the yield [A01].
Why it matters: group sharing-road; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec10-F01 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec10-R02 | anchor: A01
Ordinary walkers earn caution, while white-cane and guide-dog walkers command legal yield under a $250 fine [A01].
Why it matters: group sharing-road; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec10-F01, sec10-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec10-R03 | anchor: A02
Silent patience serves blind crossers, while step-back plus pocketed cane means roll [A02].
Why it matters: group sharing-road; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec10-F03 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec10-R04 | anchor: A02
Bike lanes ban cars outright, excepting alleys, driveways, duty, orders, and emergencies [A02].
Why it matters: group sharing-road; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec10-F05 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec10-R05 | anchor: A02
Sudden slows overmatch bike brakes, while surprise honks swerve riders into harm [A02].
Why it matters: group sharing-road; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec10-F06 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec10-R06 | anchor: A03
Cyclists owe hand signals, yet may grip both bars, so read their head tells [A03].
Why it matters: group sharing-road; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec10-F08 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0069]

FACT_ID: sec10-R07 | anchor: A03
Cyclists obey drivers' controls on roads, yet yield sidewalks to walkers and light up at night [A03].
Why it matters: group sharing-road; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec10-F10, sec10-F11 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0069]

FACT_ID: sec10-R08 | anchor: A04
Scooters admit riders 16 and older, yet demand lamps from dusk-half-hour to dawn-half-hour [A04].
Why it matters: group sharing-road; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec10-F13, sec10-F14 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec10-R09 | anchor: A04
Motorcycles claim whole lanes, plus 4-second trails stretching longer when wet [A04].
Why it matters: group sharing-road; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec10-F15 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec10-R10 | anchor: A05
Side zones punish lingerers beside trailers, while front zones punish divers ahead of them [A05].
Why it matters: group sharing-road; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec10-F18, sec10-F19 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec10-R11 | anchor: A05
Front zones measure 335 feet of braking, while rear zones reach 200 feet of blindness [A05].
Why it matters: group sharing-road; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec10-F19, sec10-F20 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec10-R12 | anchor: A06
Trucks swing left to turn right, while meeting cars hug far right [A06].
Why it matters: group sharing-road; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec10-F21 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec10-R13 | anchor: A06
Cutting rigs off courts death, while escape ramps serve doomed trucks alone [A06].
Why it matters: group sharing-road; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec10-F22 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec10-R14 | anchor: A07
Sirens order an immediate right-side freeze, while tailing them within 500 feet breaks the law [A07].
Why it matters: group sharing-road; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec10-F24 [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec10-R15 | anchor: A07
Stops open with hands frozen on the wheel, while papers move only after announced slow reaches [A07].
Why it matters: group sharing-road; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec10-F25, sec10-F26 [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec10-R16 | anchor: A08
Open lanes shift away from shouldered iron, while blocked lanes slow with care [A08].
Why it matters: group sharing-road; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec10-F28 [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0074]

FACT_ID: sec10-R17 | anchor: A08
Triangle crawlers creep under 25 mph, while horse-drawn kin spook at horns and revs [A08].
Why it matters: group sharing-road; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec10-F29, sec10-F30 [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0074]

FACT_ID: sec10-R18 | anchor: A09
ATVs demand consent plus helmets, and cross roads only near 90 degrees under 2/10 of a mile [A09].
Why it matters: group sharing-road; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec10-F32, sec10-F33 [A09].
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0075]
